# Joey Jazwinski

> Software Developer, Full-Stack Engineer, and Creator building modern web experiences and interactive developer utilities.

## Core Expertise
- Full-Stack Web Development (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js)
- Browser-based Developer Utilities & Real-Time Client Tools
- Cybersecurity Fundamentals & Network Defense
- User Experience (UX) Architecture & Design Systems
- Generative AI Workflow Integration & Prompt Engineering

## Online Developer Utilities & Tools
- [Developer Tools Hub](https://joeyjazwinski.com/developer-tools): Suite of 100% free client-side browser utilities.
- [QR Code Generator](https://joeyjazwinski.com/developer-tools/qrcode-generator): High-resolution customizable QR code generator.
- [JSON Formatter](https://joeyjazwinski.com/developer-tools/json-formatter): Fast client-side JSON parser, validator, and formatter.
- [RegEx Tester](https://joeyjazwinski.com/developer-tools/regex-tester): Interactive color-coded regular expression match analyzer.
- [JWT Debugger](https://joeyjazwinski.com/developer-tools/jwt-debugger): Decode, inspect, and verify JSON Web Token signatures safely client-side.
- [Diff Checker](https://joeyjazwinski.com/developer-tools/diff-checker): Visual side-by-side text diffing utility using LCS algorithm.
- [Image Compressor](https://joeyjazwinski.com/developer-tools/image-compressor): Client-side PNG, JPEG, and WebP compression and resizing.
- [GIF Generator](https://joeyjazwinski.com/developer-tools/gif-generator): In-browser video to animated GIF transcoder.
- [Contrast Checker](https://joeyjazwinski.com/developer-tools/contrast-checker): WCAG 2.1 color accessibility compliance analyzer.
- [Code Sandbox](https://joeyjazwinski.com/developer-tools/code-sandbox): Live HTML/CSS sandbox testing playground.
- [Hash Generator](https://joeyjazwinski.com/developer-tools/hash-generator): Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 hashes instantly.
- [SVG Optimizer](https://joeyjazwinski.com/developer-tools/svg-optimizer): Clean and minify SVG vector files client-side.
